components.name: Number Field
components.description: A labeled native number input with optional enhanced step buttons.
accessibility: The native type=number input owns typing, ArrowUp/Down, validation, FormData and reset. Values are not silently clamped while typing. Initial values must be in bounds and on the native step grid; min may equal max. Numeric steps only: arbitrary-step input is better served by Input.

Without JavaScript the extra buttons stay hidden and the native number input remains usable. Reset updates step availability after the native reset action. Host code assigning value, bounds or disabled state should dispatch input or change to synchronize buttons. There is no persistence or auto-submission.

components.name: Toggle Group
components.description: A named set of toggle commands with single or multiple pressed states.
accessibility: Uses role=group with native pressed buttons. Every available button remains a normal Tab stop; no toolbar/radio keyboard model is implied. Single mode permits zero or one pressed item. Multiple mode permits any combination.
Values must be unique and nonempty, and initial selections must refer to items. Icon-only items require icons and retain stable names and shared tooltips. Disabled buttons cannot be activated.

Bubbling toggle-group:change exposes detail.values. The host applies effects and persistence. These commands do not submit form values or automatically reset with a form; use Radio Group or Checkbox for form choices.
